evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Story requires music fingerprinting/index creation but backlog contains no complementary story to ingest music or generate fingerprints for content identification.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based search presupposes creation/management of user profiles; backlog contains no story that creates or stores user profiles/preferences required by this feature.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: This requires user profile creation and similarity computation based on stored user data; no story creates or persists user profiles or user-history data needed for this.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Requires computing and storing content-similarity metadata for music videos (fingerprints/features); backlog lacks ingest/fingerprint/similarity-generation stories for music/video content.

evaluations.evidence: exploit enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes a video upload story (ZO-006) and several metadata/tagging/prefiltering admin stories (ZO-024, ZO-026) that provide the complementary capability to exploit enriched metadata and tags.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: This story provides the creation/ingestion capability (upload + tags) and is present; no complementary creation step is absent for the stated intent.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Viewing thumbnails of segments requires a segmentation/segment-generation step; backlog has no generic story to generate video segments (only project-specific segment tasks), so the necessary segmentation creation is missing.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Providing info about segments requires segments to exist and similarity metadata; backlog lacks a generic segment-generation story and general similarity-indexing creation for segments.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: This requires computed perceptual-similarity indices and segment-level feature extraction; there is no story that generically creates segment-level features or indices across videos.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation from similar profiles depends on stored user profiles and behavioral data; backlog does not include a story creating/storing user profile or activity histories needed for this.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Feature requires ingesting and indexing local news events (news detection) and mapping them to content; there is no story to ingest/track news events or to geo-index news, so complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person-identification requires a person identity database or linking to external knowledge and an enrollment/creation process for identities; backlog lacks a story to create/manage such identity/reference data.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification needs a product reference database and ingestion of product metadata; backlog contains no story to create or manage the product reference data required for returning related information.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Logo identification requires a logo reference set and onboarding of logo templates; backlog lacks a complementary story to create/manage such a reference dataset.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification similarly requires a brand database or knowledge base; no backlog story provides creation/management of that complementary resource.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Cross-modal image-to-video retrieval requires indexing video frames/features and an image-to-video matching pipeline; the backlog has no story that creates the video-index or the cross-modal matching indices needed.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: This needs geo-tagging of videos and a geospatial index of content; the backlog has no story creating or ingesting geographic metadata for videos (geo-tagging), so the required complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search requires ASR transcription generation and indexing of transcripts; no backlog story creates transcripts or indexes audio speech for search, so complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Editing segmentation presumes segment data exists; there is no generic story to automatically create video segmentation across the platform (only project-specific segmentation tasks), so the creation step is missing.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotating segments and extracting topics requires that segments exist; generic segmentation creation is missing from the backlog, so a necessary complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Backlog contains relevant audio/video quality assessment and preprocessing stories (e.g., ZO-046, ZO-022) that provide the complementary analysis needed for filtering/ranking by quality.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: This admin analysis story is self-contained (the capability to assess edit detection is the feature) and no additional creation step is required beyond ingestion (ZO-006).

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering nudity is an admin action that presumes a detection algorithm; the backlog includes prefiltering/admin stories and does not require an additional complementary create story to be specified here.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level feature extraction and search are covered by several preclassification/admin stories (e.g., ZO-030) so the complementary capabilities are present in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: The story itself specifies the automatic validation capability; no missing complementary creation step is evident beyond ingestion which is covered by ZO-006.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tags are created via upload (ZO-006) or recognition stories; complementary capability for using metadata in search is present in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: This depends on citizen annotations and Talk comment creation (volunteer-side annotation/comment submission) but the backlog contains no stories enabling volunteers to annotate or post Talk comments, so the complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Detection based on annotations/Talk presumes those volunteer contributions exist; backlog lacks volunteer-annotation or Talk comment creation stories, so the required input is missing.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Identifying volunteer types requires collection and storage of volunteer behavior/activity data or profiles; backlog has no story that creates/persists volunteer activity or profile data needed for this classification.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: This is a self-contained preclassification creation story; it specifies the generation of low-level features and thus provides its own complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: The story itself is a detection/creation capability for that project; no further complementary creation is required in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: This story provides a specific detection capability (creation of series detection); no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific preclassification is a self-contained creation capability; backlog includes it, so no complementary story is missing for that goal.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: This is a project-level preclassification creation feature and does not depend on absent complementary stories in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: This detection capability is specified as a standalone creation feature for the project; no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: This story provides the segmentation/localization creation capability for the Plankton Portal domain; it supplies the complementary step needed for that project.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: The detection capability is defined in the story and does not rely on any missing complementary creation step outside the project scope.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: This is a contained detection/preclassification capability for the project; no missing complementary story is required.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific preclassification is included and provides the necessary creation capability within the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: This story defines the analysis/creation capability for that project and does not depend on other missing backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: This detection capability is self-contained for the Worm Watch Lab project; no missing complementary creation story is required.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: The story itself specifies the required detection capability for satellite images; no additional missing complementary step is evident.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Assessing weight based on experience requires captured volunteer activity/experience data (profile/history); backlog lacks stories to record/store volunteer experience/activities, so the complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: This is a project/admin preprocessing capability; the story itself describes the necessary creation/detection and no extra complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: This detection capability is standalone and does not depend on an absent complementary story in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: This preprocessing capability is present as a concrete creation/action and does not require an absent complementary story.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Story specifies grouping capability (creation of clusters) for whale calls; no missing complementary creation step is evident in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: This detection capability is specified as a standalone analytic feature; backlog contains it and no complementary creation story is missing.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Interrupting volunteers requires real-time monitoring of volunteer state/activities and an intervention mechanism; backlog contains no story to capture volunteer session state or to perform interventions, so the complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Selecting interruption modality presupposes an interruption delivery mechanism and volunteer session/context capture; backlog lacks stories to create/manage volunteer session state and deliver interruptions, so required complementary steps are absent.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Detecting when to educate requires tracking volunteer performance/metrics and an education-delivery mechanism; backlog contains no story to record performance or deliver education, so complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Selecting education modality requires both volunteer monitoring and an education-delivery mechanism; backlog lacks stories to capture volunteer state and to deliver those modalities, so a complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Choosing education content depends on volunteer activity data, classification history, or annotations; backlog lacks creation/persistence of volunteer activity and educational-content management stories, so complementary capabilities are missing.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: This requires a comment/Talk system and comment ingestion/annotation; backlog contains no story enabling volunteers to post Talk comments or to store/query them, so the complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Triggering Zoonibot comments requires a comment infrastructure and event detection tied to comments; backlog lacks the comment/posting system stories necessary for this automation.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: This depends on a comment/interaction channel and detection of explanation triggers; backlog lacks the comment/interaction creation stories required for Zoonibot to act on, so complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Determining Zoonibot messages requires an interaction/content management capability and recorded volunteer context; backlog lacks stories to create/store interaction context and manage bot responses, so complementary steps are absent.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes multiple similarity/grouping and preclassification stories across projects; while implementation detail remains, the complementary similarity/grouping capability is represented in the backlog (project-specific), so no missing complementary story is evident.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Recommending projects based on past experiences requires recorded volunteer histories/profiles; the backlog lacks stories to capture and store volunteer previous experience/activity needed for such recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: The story itself is a content summarization/consumption capability; no additional complementary creation step is required beyond ingestion which is implied by context, and no missing complementary story is evident in the backlog.
